source: Good Sam PUBLIC_PARK rows with no entry within 2 km (50; 25 after military/PG&E), RV Life county/city/regional/dnr rows plus gov-keyword commercial/state rows with no entry within 2 km (139), and all 1,488 unmatched named OSM campsites read (op-tagged in full, the rest by name). Each candidate checked BY NAME against the DB first.
note: 36 adds on top of 138 local entries. The big finding: the 2026-07 CA private sweep price-gated RV Life's 'commercial' rows (<=$$), which silently dropped agency campgrounds RV Life tags commercial at $$$ - water/irrigation-district lakes (EBMUD Camanche + Pardee, Don Pedro Fleming Meadows, NID Scotts Flat + Rollins, Helix Lake Jennings, Padre Dam Santee Lakes, Collins), city lakes (Dixon) and fairgrounds. The local tier has no price gate, so they came back here. The SoCal county-park systems themselves were already well covered.
